```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(pROC)
library(rpart)
library(rpart.plot)
library(randomForest)
library(xgboost)
modeling_data <- readRDS("steal_modeling_data.rds")
```

## Train/test split

```{r}
set.seed(123)

train_index <- sample(
  1:nrow(modeling_data),
  size = 0.7 * nrow(modeling_data)
)

train_data <- modeling_data[train_index, ]
test_data  <- modeling_data[-train_index, ]
```

## Model 1: Multiple logistic regression

```{r}
logit_model <- glm(
  safe_binary ~ top_speed + jump,
  data = train_data,
  family = binomial
)

summary(logit_model)
```
## Predictions

```{r}
test_data <- test_data %>%
  mutate(
    logit_prob = predict(
      logit_model,
      newdata = test_data,
      type = "response"
    ),
    logit_pred = if_else(logit_prob >= 0.75, "Safe", "Out")
  )

table(
  Predicted = test_data$logit_pred,
  Actual = test_data$outcome_factor
)

exp(coef(logit_model))
```

## Model 2: Decision Tree

```{r}
library(rpart)
library(rpart.plot)

tree_model <- rpart(
  outcome_factor ~ top_speed + jump,
  data = train_data,
  method = "class"
)

rpart.plot(tree_model)
```
## Predictions

```{r}
tree_prob <- predict(
  tree_model,
  newdata = test_data,
  type = "prob"
)[, "Safe"]

tree_pred <- if_else(tree_prob >= 0.5, "Safe", "Out")

table(
  Predicted = tree_pred,
  Actual = test_data$outcome_factor
)
```
## Model 3: Random forest

```{r}
set.seed(123)

rf_model <- randomForest(
  outcome_factor ~ top_speed + jump,
  data = train_data,
  ntree = 500,
  importance = TRUE
)
```

## Predictions

```{r}
rf_prob <- predict(
  rf_model,
  newdata = test_data,
  type = "prob"
)[, "Safe"]

rf_pred <- if_else(rf_prob >= 0.643, "Safe", "Out")

table(
  Predicted = factor(rf_pred, levels = c("Out", "Safe")),
  Actual = factor(test_data$outcome_factor, levels = c("Out", "Safe"))
)
```
```{r}
library(pROC)

rf_roc <- roc(
  response = test_data$safe_binary,
  predictor = rf_prob
  )

rf_best_thresh <- coords(
  rf_roc,
  x = "best",
  best.method = "youden",
  ret = "threshold"
)

rf_best_thresh
```

## Model 4: 

```{r}
library(xgboost)
library(pROC)
library(tidyverse)

# Matrix inputs

x_train <- train_data %>%
  select(top_speed, jump) %>%
  as.matrix()

y_train <- train_data$safe_binary

x_test <- test_data %>%
  select(top_speed, jump) %>%
  as.matrix()

y_test <- test_data$safe_binary

# Convert to XGBoost format

dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data = x_train,
  label = y_train
)

dtest <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data = x_test,
  label = y_test
)

# XGBoost Model

set.seed(123)

xgb_model <- xgboost(
  data = dtrain,
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  eval_metric = "auc",
  nrounds = 50,
  max_depth = 2,
  eta = 0.1,
  subsample = 0.8,
  colsample_bytree = 1,
  verbose = 0
)

xgb_model
```

## Predictions

```{r}
xgb_prob <- predict(
  xgb_model,
  newdata = dtest
)

summary(xgb_prob)

xgb_pred <- if_else(
  xgb_prob >= 0.7376609,
  "Safe",
  "Out"
)

table(
  Predicted = factor(xgb_pred_50, levels = c("Out", "Safe")),
  Actual = factor(test_data$outcome_factor, levels = c("Out", "Safe"))
)

xgb_accuracy <- mean(xgb_pred == test_data$outcome_factor)

xgb_auc <- pROC::auc(
  response = test_data$safe_binary,
  predictor = xgb_prob
)

xgb_accuracy
```

```{r}
xgb_roc <- roc(
  response = test_data$safe_binary,
  predictor = xgb_prob
)

xgb_best_thresh <- coords(
  xgb_roc,
  x = "best",
  best.method = "youden",
  ret = "threshold"
)

xgb_best_thresh
```

## Feature importance

```{r}

xgb_importance <- xgb.importance(
  feature_names = colnames(x_train),
  model = xgb_model
)

xgb_importance

xgb.plot.importance(xgb_importance)
```
## Model 5: Bootstrapping

```{r}
set.seed(123)

B <- 1000

bootstrap_coefs <- replicate(B, {
  
  boot_data <- train_data %>%
    slice_sample(
      n = nrow(train_data),
      replace = TRUE
    )
  
  boot_model <- glm(
    safe_binary ~ top_speed + jump,
    data = boot_data,
    family = binomial
  )
  
  coef(boot_model)
})

bootstrap_coefs <- t(bootstrap_coefs)

bootstrap_coefs <- as.data.frame(bootstrap_coefs)

head(bootstrap_coefs)
```
## Results

```{r}
bootstrap_summary <- tibble(
  term = names(coef(logit_model)),
  original_estimate = coef(logit_model),
  bootstrap_mean = colMeans(bootstrap_coefs, na.rm = TRUE),
  lower_95 = apply(bootstrap_coefs, 2, quantile, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
  upper_95 = apply(bootstrap_coefs, 2, quantile, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
)

bootstrap_summary
```

```{r}
bootstrap_coefs_long <- bootstrap_coefs %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "term",
    values_to = "coefficient"
  )

ggplot(bootstrap_coefs_long, aes(x = coefficient)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  facet_wrap(~ term, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    title = "Bootstrap Distributions of Logistic Regression Coefficients",
    x = "Coefficient Estimate",
    y = "Count"
  )
```
